```{r setup}
kit <- local({
  d <- getwd(); while (!file.exists(file.path(d, "R", "lhcb_domain.R")) && dirname(d) != d) d <- dirname(d); d
})
TBL <- file.path(kit, "tables_r", "statistical_audit")
FIG <- file.path(kit, "figures_r", "statistical_audit")
rd  <- function(f) { p <- file.path(TBL, f); if (file.exists(p)) utils::read.csv(p, check.names = FALSE) else NULL }
figp <- function(f) file.path(FIG, f)
show <- function(df, n = 50) { if (is.null(df)) cat("_table unavailable_\n") else knitr::kable(utils::head(df, n)) }
```

> **Interpretation boundary.** The same LHCb open data analysed in R and Python
> is a **cross-language computational reproduction**, not independent
> experimental replication. The smooth/KDE baseline is **not** a full Standard
> Model amplitude analysis (no official acceptance, efficiency, detector
> response, form factors, hadronic uncertainties or covariance). Nothing here
> claims new physics, SM failure, WCT proof, or LHCb endorsement.

# 1. Executive summary

The audit wraps the canonical Python pipeline and its R reproduction with
explicit statistical controls. The headline conclusions:

- Stage 09d's best **local** peak is `k2 = 23.08`; **`19.5296` is a surviving
  reference location, not the best local peak**.
- **Amplitude bounds are active** in the key 09d/12/13 fits (A2 sits on its 0.10
  cap on a majority of scan points).
- Stage 12's integer winding **switches branch with bandwidth** (n=10 at low
  bandwidth, n=20 at high bandwidth): not a stable unique winding.
- In the committed stage-13 family at bandwidth scale 1, **Q=4/9 outscores
  Q=2/3** (ΔD 457 vs 373); the parity bounds are coefficient-wise, so radial
  amplitudes exceed 0.1.
- The **sideband-subtracted control (stage 28) retains none** of the claimed
  structures (best Δχ² ≈ 5.3, p ≈ 0.82; reference mode, n15 and the 10/15/20
  comb all fail).
- The **charm-trimmed B sidebands (stage 29) carry stronger structure than the
  signal window** (low-SB ≈ 956, high-SB ≈ 1045 vs signal ≈ 353).
- Net: the controls **materially weaken** any signal-specific or new-physics
  reading of the log-periodic structure.

# 23. Limitations

- Replay mode summarises committed scan/null tables; event-level full-pipeline
  nulls, KDE re-estimation, holdout, 09d injection and KDE calibration require
  the OAuth-gated ROOT ntuples (full mode).
- Empirical p-values are floored at 1/(B+1); no claim is made below Monte-Carlo
  resolution.
- AIC/BIC at a selected frequency/comb do not pay for the model search; the
  family correction does.
